jobs.title: Factory smoke test (chat lane)
jobs.plain: Checks what a normal ChatGPT chat can do (save files, open PRs, screenshots).

jobs.title: Factory smoke test (Work lane)
jobs.plain: Checks what Sol Work mode can do (terminal, npm, Firebase emulator).

jobs.title: Fast regression CI on every gameplay push
jobs.plain: GitHub runs every gameplay test automatically on each worker save.

jobs.title: Two-manager journey on the emulator (provider level)
jobs.plain: Daniel and Nik play a whole Showdown against the real Rules in a test database, with a stranger and privacy checks.

jobs.title: Simultaneous result taps: loser gets stale, not denied
jobs.plain: When you both submit a result at once, the slower tap is told to refresh instead of getting an error.

jobs.title: Two-manager browser journey (localhost-only emulator switch)
jobs.plain: The same journey through the real app screens in a browser, test database only.

jobs.title: Composed production Rules regression
jobs.plain: Re-proves the full production Rules after the new career-data Rules land.

jobs.title: Pure shared career model + tests
jobs.plain: One pure function that turns Showdown data into the career numbers every screen shows.

jobs.title: Active Showdown adapter (Rivalry, Continue, tiebreak, final state)
jobs.plain: Live Showdown (Rivalry, Continue, tiebreak, final result) feeds the career model.

jobs.title: Renderer seams: screens take a model, never the local path
jobs.plain: Screens read from that career model instead of from one phone's local data.

jobs.title: Start/Join view model + nav.locked
jobs.plain: Start/Join screen and top-bar locking driven by one view model.

jobs.title: Contract fixtures generated from the real model
jobs.plain: Example data for Team V generated from the real model, so visuals and gameplay agree.

jobs.title: Career index Rules + client + emulator proofs
jobs.plain: A shared list of every Showdown the two of you played, protected by Rules.

jobs.title: Completed-only read grant + session-free reader
jobs.plain: Finished Showdowns stay readable for both managers after they close.

jobs.title: Closed-Showdown adapter into the career model
jobs.plain: Finished Showdowns flow into career totals and the Trophy Room.

jobs.title: Transfer history, completed only
jobs.plain: Transfer history visible only once a challenge is completed.

jobs.title: Part 1: Trophy Room and Career Statistics on the real career model
jobs.plain: Part 1 merged into recovery (PR #347, 86111ca): Trophy Room and Career Statistics show Team V's screens on the real career model. Legacy and Rivalry Statistics stay hidden for part 2. Not live until Nik approves Team V's full package.

jobs.title: Acceptance: directive §12 and Sol's 8 proofs on the emulator
jobs.plain: Final acceptance run of every promised behaviour in the test database. Superseded 2026-10-05: SSJR is retired and version 2.0 is live; the real proof is Nik and Daniel playing 2.0 (G-F1).

jobs.title: One real two-device run with Nik
jobs.plain: One real game on two phones with Daniel, to sign it off. Superseded 2026-10-05: SSJR is retired and version 2.0 is live; the real proof is Nik and Daniel playing 2.0 (G-F1).

jobs.title: Nik's pair code survives the pair-panel re-render
jobs.plain: When Nik pastes Daniel's code quickly, the app keeps it instead of wiping it and wrongly calling it invalid.

jobs.title: Resume a Shared Showdown after reload; closed Showdowns stay on Home
jobs.plain: After a reload both players land on Home, rejoin a fresh session and pick up on the right season, instead of starting over at season 1.

jobs.title: A late season acknowledgement retries instead of failing
jobs.plain: When both players press acknowledge at the same moment, the second one is retried instead of showing a permission error.

jobs.title: Same-moment taps retry quietly (bug hunt 1)
jobs.plain: When both players tap START, a lock button, early end or Setup confirm at the same moment, or the transfer timer hits 0:00 on both phones, the slower phone retries once instead of showing an error.

jobs.title: Part 2a: foundation (loader, top bar, shared kit, caching)
jobs.plain: Start first: one shared way to load Team V's screens, the top bar, and lighter caching. Built in the lead thread by a helper (Nik, 2026-10-04: no cloud sessions).

jobs.title: Part 2b: Home, music (Audius) and Loading
jobs.plain: Home in Team V's style with Nik's Audius playlist playing across screens; Loading keeps the Reus credit. Codex builds (Nik pastes the box); starts from job 24's branch; the lead checks each screen in a browser and merges.

jobs.title: Part 2c: Start/Join, League wheel and Club packs
jobs.plain: Setup screens skinned without touching pairing, session or draw logic. Lead helper (Opus); starts from job 24's branch; the lead checks each screen in a browser and merges.

jobs.title: Part 2d: Transfer War
jobs.plain: Transfer window skinned; private inputs stay private; lock confirm and quiet retries kept. Lead helper (Opus); starts from job 24's branch; the lead checks each screen in a browser and merges.

jobs.title: Part 2e: Rivalry Statistics and Legacy (History)
jobs.plain: Same pattern as job 13 on the real career model; un-hides the last two Statistics buttons. Sol 6.1 Work mode, High; starts from job 24's branch; the lead checks each screen in a browser and merges.

jobs.title: Part 2f: Season Results, Final Winner and Standings
jobs.plain: Results and commit skinned (clash warning kept); winner reveal uses the reconciliation exactly. Sol Work mode; starts from job 24's branch; the lead checks each screen in a browser and merges.

jobs.title: Part 2g: Rule Book and Settings
jobs.plain: Rules copy unchanged, Settings controls kept, credits added. Sol 6.1 Work mode, High; starts from job 24's branch; the lead checks each screen in a browser and merges.

jobs.title: Ten-season games: session expiry, long-game limits, 10-season emulator run
jobs.plain: A 10-season game now survives the 4-hour private session ending mid-game: one banner, one RECONNECT SESSION tap, Daniel hosts, Nik joins, both pages return by themselves. CI now plays 3 and 10 seasons with a mid-game expiry. PR #350, merged into recovery fb0dd02. Still open: the 72-character code exchange (needs a Rules change) and a misleading transfer message after expiry.

jobs.title: Fewer taps: audit the flow for steps we can safely drop
jobs.plain: Audit done: /mnt/project-files/gameplay/TAP_AUDIT_2026-10-04.md. 8 reductions; R1-R6 and R8 being built in job 33; R7 (commit + acknowledge in one tap) waits on Nik.

jobs.title: Fewer taps: auto-refresh while waiting, skip hops, drop duplicate banners
jobs.plain: About 13 fewer taps for Daniel and 6 for Nik over 3 seasons, plus no refresh taps. Every lock, publish, commit, acknowledge and close stays a manual tap. Lead helper (Opus).

bug_hunt.title: Both managers tap at the same second and the slower one sees an error
bug_hunt.plain: Hits Career Start, the Transfer Challenge locks and timer, and Setup confirm. Nothing is corrupted, but the loser must tap again.

bug_hunt.title: A tied season is decided by league position
bug_hunt.plain: Code and old notes disagree on equal non-zero scores.
bug_hunt.note: Nik chose league position; docs fixed in PR #343 (merged)

bug_hunt.title: Nobody cross-checks the two managers' season results
bug_hunt.plain: Both can publish position 1 or both tick Champions League. Nik chose (2026-10-04) to warn, not block: the commit screen now shows a CHECK RESULTS line on a clash and committing stays allowed (PR #346, merged into recovery dc78ed7). Live since r53.

bug_hunt.title: Lock buttons have no confirm
bug_hunt.plain: One stray tap on LOCK MY GUESSES or LOCK MY SIGNINGS locks an empty list for the season; the helpful error text is hidden behind a code. Lock buttons now ask "Lock N of 3?" when a form is partly filled (PR #345, merged into recovery 6974408). Live since r53.
bug_hunt.note: PR #345 adds the "Lock N of 3?" confirm; live since r53 (2026-10-04)

bug_hunt.title: The 4-hour private session ends long games
bug_hunt.plain: A 5 or 10 season game outlives one session, so both managers must open a fresh one. Needs one retest mid-season. Now job 31 (ten-season games).
bug_hunt.note: job 31, PR #350 (fb0dd02): one-tap reconnect after expiry; live since 2.0 (r54)
